$comment: Engine feature probes the approved K11 correction (APR-JE-029, finding F-G5-04) depends on. check:supports compares each engine's real answer with this record and with what the page actually does, so a browser or Playwright upgrade that changes the answer is reported instead of silently changing the rendering. If an entry changes, review the correction and the normal-appearance comparison against v0.8, then update this file.

features.why: Only WebKit supports hanging-punctuation, so the rule that lets the Visit hours day label wrap (and never be narrower than its text) applies only in WebKit, where a stale table column width let the nowrap label overflow into the hours under a visitor's text spacing.
